description: Presidential Secretariat - Amended the Duties & Functions published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1933/13 of 21.09.2015 by an Insertion to the Heading "Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs (No. 4)" w.e.f. 31.10.2016
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of a legal notification under the Constitution of Sri Lanka. It specifically modifies the list of Acts under the purview of a ministry by adding the "Payment Devices Frauds Act, No. 30 of 2006." This constitutes a legal/regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and modifications to existing legislation, fitting the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes). While it mentions the President and a ministry, the core content is about legal framework changes rather than government personnel or structural changes.
